data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that provides numeric pagination controls.
data.what_it_does: It displays page numbers, next/previous arrows, and optional items‑per‑page selector. The widget notifies when the page or items‑per‑page changes so the UI can update accordingly.
use_when: You need a simple numeric pagination UI for tables or lists
You want a ready‑made pager without writing custom logic
avoid_when: You require infinite scrolling or virtual pagination
You need highly custom styling beyond the provided options
strengths: Supports items‑per‑page selection and arrow disabling
weaknesses: No built‑in integration with data fetching logic
